prompt: Take a look at my Claude Code conversations from the last week or so and give me a real read on how I'm doing. I want the scorecard, the patterns you see across conversations, and the 1-2 things that would actually move the needle if I changed them. Be honest, not flattering.

assertions.text: Output shows evidence of actually reading JSONL transcript files from ~/.claude/projects/, not generic recommendations
Output covers at least 3 distinct conversations (cites them or references them)
Output includes a 'patterns across conversations' section identifying repeated behaviors
Output includes a scorecard table covering at least 5 of the 7 rubric dimensions
Output has at most 3 prioritized next moves
Recommendations reference concrete moments/quotes from conversations, not abstract advice
Tone is honest and direct (matches 'be honest not flattering' ask), no padding
